configuration: MoveCare platform in the 10-week home pilot: Giraff-X robot, environmental sensors, smart objects, community activity centre, and cloud Virtual Caregiver.
sources_read: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12369-021-00843-0 — publisher full text of the same paper

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Environmental observations and CBAC activity reports enter cloud storage.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: The VC queries historical activity and measurement records to decide reminders.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Intervention plans trigger user searches and targeted questions or repeat measurements.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Stored sensor-annotated apartment maps guide interpretation of PIR and door readings.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Generated interventions enter a retained pending queue; help-scenario executions are logged for subsequent reporting.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The service logs help-scenario executions for its later caregiver reports.
record.quote: The Call for Help scenario is then logged as a true positive

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Replies to the robot's spot questions are retained for weekly reporting.
outcome.quote: answer given to the Spot Questions

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Missing answers are linked to the attempted dialogue, triggering repetition and rescheduling.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: No durable self-modification is specified; pilot software updates were implemented by developers.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: R2 uses developer updates; execution under a service-authored revision is not reported.

notes: Independent text-only review of the with-robot configuration; no repository. Direct PMC access returned a browser check, so indexed PMC text and publisher full text were read.
